branches.description: Touch a creature and swap looks for eight seconds: you take its shape, it wears yours, and its own kind turn on it.

branches.name: Practised Manner
branches.description: In a person's shape, people watching you raise Suspicion half as fast, and it fades twice as fast.

branches.name: Long Con
branches.description: You can study a person from 12 blocks away, not 6.

branches.name: Doppelganger
branches.description: Leave a copy of your shape that walks on ahead for eight seconds. Every mob hunting you follows it instead, and it bursts on the first blow.

branches.name: Social Engineering
branches.description: Taking a person's shape calls their pets to you at once, and Familiar lasts thirty seconds.

styles.name: Apex Predator
styles.description: Offense Ultimate. Plates close over you and open on a ravager (a wolf where a ravager won't fit): it pins the foe, mauls it, tosses it and brings it down, then bursts into plates. 24 damage to the foe and 5 to everyone near the landing. The foe is held the whole time and can't hurt you.

styles.name: Living Fortress
styles.description: Defense Ultimate. For 12 seconds you wear plates of your own making from head to foot: blows land at less than half, nothing knocks you down, and anyone who strikes you cuts themselves on the edges. The plates burst off as it ends.

styles.name: Many Faces
styles.description: Support Ultimate. Four copies of you walk off in four directions, and everything hunting you or a friend within 20 blocks goes after a copy instead. For 12 seconds friends within 12 blocks mend and move quicker.

branches.name: Undertow
branches.description: Water Whip's crack drags its target a step toward you instead of away, and every whip hits Soaked enemies 25% harder.

branches.name: Geyser
branches.description: Mark a spot up to 22 blocks away; a moment later a column of water bursts up there, throwing everyone on it skyward (6 + level). A Crashing Wave that rolls over the mark sets it off at once.

branches.name: Riptide
branches.description: Crashing Wave carries everything it catches all the way to the end of its run and slams them down there.

branches.name: Brine Edge
branches.description: Ice Daggers freeze Soaked enemies solid for a second, and a lash that strikes a frozen enemy hits twice as hard.

branches.name: Pressure Jet
branches.description: Push a thin, high-pressure jet of water from both palms for two seconds: it hurts and shoves whatever it touches and puts out fire. Shift stops it. Each tenth-second contact deals 0.65 + 0.1 per tier damage.

branches.name: Tsunami Heart
branches.description: Standing in water, your Crashing Wave rises twice as wide and tall, and Maelstrom's Deluge sends a wave rolling out in every direction.

branches.name: Leviathan
branches.description: Open a pool on a spot up to 20 blocks away and raise a serpent of water out of it. It strikes three times, each at the nearest foe within 10 blocks of the pool: it rears back while a ring of water marks the spot (step off it to dodge), then lunges for 4 + tier/2, dragging whoever it bites toward the pool, slowing them and putting out fires. Then it dives. Press again to send it down after the strike in progress.

branches.name: Slipstream
branches.description: Flow Steps leave a slick of water for three seconds that slows and soaks enemies on it, and your next lash reaches half again as far.

branches.name: Tide Wall
branches.description: Raise a curved wall of water two blocks ahead for five seconds. It swallows shots, soaks and slows enemies who walk through it, and a Water Whip cast through it is twice as thick and reaches farther.

branches.name: Child of the Sea
branches.description: See clearly underwater, Octopus Form's arms reach twice as far in water, and Wave Rider runs half again as fast and twice as long on water.

branches.name: Return Current
branches.description: Shots your Octopus Form, Tide Wall or Tidal Dome swallow are flung back at whoever fired them.

branches.name: Water Spout
branches.description: Ride a pillar of water up to eight blocks high for six seconds, drifting where you look and knocking enemies from its foot. Press again to crash down in a splash (5 + level).

branches.name: Endless Tide
branches.description: Wave Rider refills your water as you ride, and leaping off its crest lands as a Crashing Wave rolling on the way you rode.

branches.name: Sea's Blessing
branches.description: Water and rain heal you twice as fast, and each second in water washes away one harmful effect.

branches.name: Healing Water
branches.description: Wrap a friend you aim at within six blocks (or yourself) in glowing water: it heals 6 + level over three seconds and washes away one harmful effect at once.

branches.name: Water Skin
branches.description: You carry half again as much water (150), and come back from death with it full.

branches.name: Soothing Tide
branches.description: Healing Water spreads to every friend within four blocks of the one you heal, at half strength.

branches.name: Rain Call
branches.description: Call a rain cloud over you for twenty seconds, ten blocks across: friends under it heal and stop burning, enemies are Soaked, fires go out and your water fills.

branches.name: Spirit Water
branches.description: Once every five minutes, with at least 30 water carried, a killing blow is turned aside: the water closes your wounds, leaving you at 8 health, and is spent.

styles.name: Riptide Barrel
styles.description: Offense Ultimate. Ride a wave in and curl its lip over the foe: it tumbles round inside the barrel, a geyser throws it clear, and two whips wrap it and slam it into a whirlpool. 25 damage to the foe; the wave and the whirlpool soak and hit everyone near. The foe is held the whole time and can't hurt you.

styles.name: Undertow Dome
styles.description: Defense Ultimate. A dome of moving water six blocks across stands round you for 12 seconds. Shots slow and sink in it, foes who wade in are swept out and soaked, and everyone inside is put out, mends and takes a third less harm.

styles.name: Monsoon
styles.description: Support Ultimate. Rain falls over 14 blocks for 15 seconds. Friends under it mend, are put out and cleansed; foes are soaked and slowed. Twice, a spring bursts up under every friend and heals them.

branches.name: Close Friends
branches.description: A Surge runs at half speed, lasting about twice as long, while you stay within three blocks of the ally.

branches.name: Partner
branches.description: Bond with the ally you look at, within 16 blocks, until you choose another. You can Supercharge your partner from across a room (16 blocks, in sight) along a red thread.

branches.name: Not Too Much
branches.description: Your partner's Overcharge backlashes are halved, overcharging them again too soon hurts half as much, and an overcharged breach of theirs never overshoots.

branches.name: Along for the Ride
branches.description: When your supercharged partner folds, breaches, dashes or teleports away while you stand within eight blocks, you go with them.

branches.name: Hold Hands
branches.description: Everyone touching your partner, a chain of friends each within two and a half blocks of the last (up to eight), shares their Surge for as long as it has left.

branches.name: Breakthrough
branches.description: A partner on your Surge can use moves one tier above what they've unlocked.

branches.name: Bigger Ball
branches.description: The ball between your hands grows twice as fast once you hold 50 Charge, and your bolts and beams reach four blocks farther.

branches.name: Van Full
branches.description: Release a burst that bounces off nearby walls: everyone within five blocks is stunned for five seconds. It spends up to 30 Charge for damage equal to Charge spent / 30, doubled where you're closed in. It knocks out rather than kills: damage leaves at least half a heart.

branches.name: Opposite Current
branches.description: Red lightning grounds out blue: with 20 Charge or more, lightning aimed at you (an Electrokinetic's or a storm's) is halved, and the half you don't take becomes Charge.

branches.name: Burn Through
branches.description: Your red lightning breaks the constructs in its path (ice walls, force barriers and bridges) and hits a foe behind a Lens Shield twice as hard.

branches.name: Overcharge the Enemy
branches.description: Pour red energy into a powered foe within 16 blocks (a player with a power, a gifted mob or Sylar). Its next move goes wild: it misfires, hurts the one who cast it and lashes at its own side.

branches.name: The Second Coming
branches.description: Stop holding back. Your red lightning, Van Full and Lightning Cannon hit twice as hard and kill instead of knocking out, and a supercharged friend in a beam's path takes it too.

branches.name: Overdrive
branches.description: Throw red lightning into everyone on your side within 12 blocks and hold them open for eight seconds: each is Surged and gets back 4 stamina a second, and your Charge runs to the top. When it ends, or when you press again, the overflow leaps from each linked body to the nearest foe within 8 blocks, 4 + tier each (alone, you throw three forks).

branches.name: Steady Hands
branches.description: Shock Therapy reaches four blocks, and also clears a dampener's hold and puts out fire.

branches.name: Burnout
branches.description: Overload a powered foe within 12 blocks until its power shuts off for four seconds: a weak window on a gifted mob or a boss. Aimed at an Ability Dampener's projector, it blows the breaker for a minute.

branches.name: Sparks for Show
branches.description: Crouch with an empty hand and red sparks dance between your fingers. Villagers who see it trade more cheaply with you; a creature hunting you with under 10 health hesitates for a second.

branches.name: Mechanic
branches.description: Jumpstart lasts twice as long and works on a TaCZ gun in your hand: its next 30 hits strike a fifth harder.

branches.name: Doorbuster
branches.description: Blast a door, gate or trapdoor within eight blocks off its hinges; whoever stands near it is knocked back and stunned for three seconds. The blast deals 1.5 damage.

branches.name: Grounded
branches.description: A fifth of the damage powered foes deal you becomes Charge instead, and your hands never spark on their own.

styles.name: Feedback Loop
styles.description: Offense Ultimate. Take the foe in front of you by the wrist and turn its own life up until it can't hold it: five jolts, then you draw the overflow into a ball of red lightning and drive it back into its chest for 21.5 damage in all. The burst forks into up to four foes near for 5 each. The foe is held the whole time and can't hurt you.

styles.name: Red Armour
styles.description: Defense Ultimate. Turn your own power all the way up for 12 seconds: blows land two-fifths lighter, each one throws a fork back into whoever struck, and you are quicker on your feet. When it burns out, it burns out into the nearest foes.

styles.name: Everyone, Now
styles.description: Support Ultimate. A red thread runs to every friend within 14 blocks and Surges them all for 12 seconds: their powers stronger and further-reaching, and themselves quicker and harder-hitting.
